newsitem.title: LATVIA: FINANCE MINISTRY TO PAY OFF EUROBOND DEBT.
newsitem.headline: FINANCE MINISTRY TO PAY OFF EUROBOND DEBT.

text.p: Latvia's finance ministry said on Tuesday that it would pay off a four billion yen, two-year eurobond on Friday that was arranged by Nomura International.
The ministry said in a statement that it would deposit 21.6 million lats in Nomura's account in Unibanka on Friday.
The bond, which represented Latvia's debut on the international capital markets, had an interest rate of 5.4 percent, the statement said.
